artists.name: Taylor Goble
artists.bio: Taylor works in delicate fine line and botanical pieces, with a soft spot for realism. Every design is drawn to sit naturally with the body and age well over time.

artists.name: Jeff Cusack
artists.bio: Jeff is rooted in bold lines and solid color. Jeff's traditional and neo traditional work is built to read clearly from across the room and hold up for decades.

artists.name: Angel
artists.bio: Angel creates heavy blackwork and dark, surreal imagery. Expect strong contrast, unusual subjects, and pieces that feel like they came out of a dream.

artists.name: Chels Johnson
artists.bio: Chels specializes in clean, minimal fine line work. These pieces are small in scale but precise, perfect for a first tattoo or a subtle addition to a collection.
